description: Remove the bounce, complaint or manual suppression of one email address. A newsletter opt-out is the reader's consent and is never removed here: when the address also has one, the result says newsletter_optout_remains true; when it has only an opt-out, the call fails with a conflict. Only lifting the opt-out with fresh consent, or resubscribing the subscriber, removes it.
name: shipmail_remove_suppression

newsletter_optout_remains.description: True when the address also has a newsletter opt-out, which stays: newsletters remain blocked until the reader is resubscribed.

title: Remove Suppression
